name: Federal bankruptcy exemptions, 11 U.S.C. § 522(d)
notes: Available only where the debtor's domicile state has not opted out under § 522(b)(2). In a joint case each debtor claims a full set (§ 522(m)) — doubling is per-debtor, not a statutory joint figure. Which state's law applies at all is § 522(b)(3)(A)'s 730-day domicile rule; that lookup is the analyzer's job, not this dataset's. All dollar figures reflect the Apr. 1, 2025 § 104(b) adjustment (90 Fed. Reg. 8941); next adjustment Apr. 1, 2028.
